lines.text: The Spirit of the LORD came on Jephthah, who vowed whatever came out his door would be a burnt offering.
The LORD delivered the Ammonites into Jephthah's hand, and he devastated twenty cities with a great blow.
Jephthah returned home to Shiloh, and his only child, his daughter, came out to meet him with tambourines.
Jephthah tore his clothes, but his daughter asked for three months in the mountains with friends, and he agreed.
After two months she returned, he did as he had vowed, and young women lament her four days yearly.
